items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I worked with the Fillmore Four out -- right before I went with Basie. They called it the Fillmore Four and One More. I was the "One More."

ctx.x: But -- go through like that. Then during that time, I made a whole series of things with the old Discovery Records with the Fillmore group. I worked with the Fillmore Four out -- right before I went with Basie. They called it the Fillmore Four and One More. I was the "One More."
